title: Ashkon se Maine
body:
ashkon se maine shaam ka darbar likh diya
phir khoone dil abid e bemaar likh diya
<<DIVIDER>>
wo naam us ka shaamil e fauje yazeed tha
qismat ne hurr ko sheh ka tarafdaar likh diya
ashkon se maine...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ki bekasi ke kayi baab khul gaye
likhne ko maine kufe ka bazaar likh diya
ashkon se maine...
<<DIVIDER>>
bemaar e karbala ke masayab na likh saka
kaagaz pe maine tauq e girabaar lik diya
ashkon se maine...
<<DIVIDER>>
tafseel e bekasi e sakina na likh saka
zindan e shaam ke dar o dewaar likh diya
ashkon se maine...
<<DIVIDER>>
abid chale to paaon ke chaalon ne khaak par
bekas ghareeb e khaafela salaar likh diya
ashkon se maine...
<<DIVIDER>>
likhna to tha ghulam hoo qambar ay viqar
khud ko ghulam e hyder e karrar likh diya
ashkon se maine...
author: Viqar Nagri
